summary: Guidelines for scoping modules: do one thing well, create separate _info or _facts modules instead of get/list states, don't require knowing all API options, encapsulate real logic, and don't make modules that run other modules (write a role).
questions: Should I add a list or info state to an existing module?
Can my module call other modules?
How much functionality should a single module have?

answer_card.title: Scoping modules
answer_card.answer_md:
- One well-defined function per module (UNIX philosophy).
- Don't add `get`/`list`/`info` states; create a separate `_info` or `_facts` module.
- Don't require knowing every underlying API option.
- Include real logic; split complex APIs into multiple modules.
- Don't duplicate other modules' work. If you want a module that runs other modules, write a **role**.
